'''Grazers''' were large creatures native to [[Abonshee|Masterhome]]. They lived in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and stood between three and four [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Godking" />
